parsed_json.up: Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (efo_id prefixed with 'EFO:'), indication_label (mesh_heading), max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_indication via molregno; molecule_dictionary to compound_structures via molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 AND drug_indication.mesh_heading = 'chronic kidney disease'. Sort: chembl_id ASC, pref_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, indication_curie ASC, indication_label ASC, max_phase_for_ind ASC.
